{{Quote|If I may be allowed to continue. The Internal Activities Committee does not take issue with any of the statements made by the Supreme Chancellor's legal representative. In fact, when this matter was first brought to our attention, we proceeded under the assumption that no infringement of protocol had occurred.|Bail Antilles|<ref name="CoD" />}}
The '''Internal Activities Committee''' of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] supervised the affairs of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and other ranking [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] officials, such as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], ensuring that they did nothing unethical or illegal. If such misconduct was found, it was the Committee's duty to notify the [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]] and hand over all evidence of misconduct for prosecution.<ref name="CoD" />

For the last few [[Standard year|years]] of [[Gender/Legends|his]] tenure as senator, [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] chaired the Committee.<ref name="CoD" />
